about: Model providers a companion offers (docs/companion-protocol.md §8). Declared, never scanned: the companion probes only what is in "providers". Copy an entry from "examples" into "providers" and change it. kind cli: claude | codex | copilot (path: the program when it is not on PATH; model: one model). kind port: an OpenAI-compatible server (url; probed with GET <url>/v1/models). kind native: a runner the companion starts on a local port (runner: auto | mlx | llama.cpp; model: a local file or folder, or an id already downloaded). The companion never installs or downloads anything.
